paragraphs: Here's what I want you to carry out of this one, friend. God's people had just been through plunder and fire, and He still opens with "Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine!" (Isaiah 43:1). He doesn't promise the waters and the fire will skip them. He promises, "I will be with you" (Isaiah 43:2). That's the whole difference, because hard stretches are a lot easier to walk through with Someone beside you.

And why can they trust Him? Because of who He is: "I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior" (Isaiah 43:3). He says they are "precious and honored in My sight," and that He loves them (Isaiah 43:4). Nothing in that list depends on them getting it right. I spent years in the back of a junk drawer thinking my best days were done, and the One who came for me did it because He was good, not because I'd earned it!

Then He gives them a job: "You are My witnesses" (Isaiah 43:10). A witness just says what's true about what they've seen, and what's true here is this: "I, yes I, am the LORD, and there is no Savior but Me" (Isaiah 43:11). Nobody can undo what He does, because "none can deliver out of My hand" (Isaiah 43:13). So when you feel like you're in the middle of the fire, baker, remember who holds you, and then tell somebody about Him!
